subject: info-acc
title: INFO.DOC.------ACC.FT.
description: Chart on book p. 517 (MP(II)-35). INFO-ACC is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism) is the partner. The title names INFO-DOC (information documentation); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: RT-DY (reality dynamics), POL-P (political policies) and INT (intention), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From RT-DY: IST-ACT (isolated activism). From POL-P: RT-T. From IST-ACT: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From RT-T: RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) and TRS (transition). From SOC-RT-DY: ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From RT-INT-TR: CN-INFO (controlled information). From ALT-F: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular).
